# AGENTS.md

<!-- Generated by `kerf agents-md` from kerf@0.1.0. Do not edit: change kerf.config.ts and regenerate. -->

This is a **kerf** app. It is not React: components run once, state is a box, and
React hooks don't exist. Run `kerf check --json` after every change; each diagnostic gives code, location, why and fix.

Start with `.kerf/map.md` (`kerf map`): what this app has and what to call.

## Rules

```tsx
import { derived } from '@kerf-js/core'

export function Cart({ items, taxRate }: {
  items: { id: string; name: string; price: number }[]
  taxRate: number
}) {
  const subtotal = derived(() =>
    items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price, 0),
  )
  const total = derived(() => subtotal.value * (1 + taxRate))
  return (
    <section>
      <ul>
        {items.map(item => <li key={item.id}>{item.name}</li>)}
      </ul>
      <p>{total.value.toFixed(2)}</p>
    </section>
  )
}
```

1. **State is a box. Read and write `.value`**, including in JSX (W015).
2. **Compute from other values with `derived`**, not `watch` or the component body (W001).
3. **JSX is live.** Each `{expr}` and attribute re-evaluates when its inputs change.
4. **Props are current.** Destructure one level (W006). Read in `derived`, `watch`, JSX or handlers.
   `const x = props.y` is a live read-only alias; `let x = props.y` and `props.y =` write locally; only `bind:y={box}`
   writes out.
5. **The body runs once.** No state-based early returns (W040) or `let` counters (W041). Branch in JSX.
6. **Pass a box only to give write access** (`value={coupon}`, child prop typed `State<string | null>`), or so list
   rows can read one entry: `cart.get(p.id)` re-runs one row, `cart[p.id]` or `cart.value[p.id]` re-runs them all
   (W017), in the list and in the row component alike.
7. **Lists and conditionals**: `.map` with `key` (W010), `&&`, ternaries. Keep items
   stable: replace only the changed item (`p.id === id ? { ...p, price } : p`), never `({ ...p })` every item
   (W014).
8. **Copy a prop into state with `state.linked(() => prop)`**, not `state(prop)` (W005). `untrack(() => …)` is a
   snapshot that never updates: never render it (W018).
9. **Side effects go in `watch(() => source, value => cleanup?)`**; DOM work in `onMount`. `flush()` applies pending
   DOM updates now.
10. **Async data is `resource(signal => fetch(…))`** (`.value .pending .error .refresh()`), never `derived(async …)` (W012).
    Loading and errors: `<Boundary pending={…} error={(e, retry) => …}>`.

**Leave props untyped**: `kerf docs props`.
Media: install media + media-ffmpeg; render ?media records with Core Media for automatic sharp previews and bounded caching. See `kerf docs media`.

## API in kerf@0.1.0

- `@kerf-js/core`: `Boundary`, `batch`, `context`, `defineState`, `derived`, `flush`, `onCleanup`, `onMount`, `resource`, `state`, `untrack`, `watch`, `state.linked`
- `@kerf-js/core/dom`: `render`, `hydrate`.
- `@kerf-js/core/ssr`: `renderToString`, `renderToStringAsync`. Never import the rest.
- `@kerf-js/core/browser`: `online`, `visible`, `lifecycle`, `media`, `on`, `interval`. Create them in setup (W051); server-rendered `media` needs `ssr` (W054). More: `kerf docs browser`; hover and press as state: `kerf docs ui-state`.
- `@kerf-js/core/surface`: canvas and WebGL, never raw `<canvas>`: `kerf docs surface`.
- `@kerf-js/core/test`: `assertNoLeaks`, `clock`, `flush`, `memoryStorage`, `net`, `page`, `render`, `scope`, `screen`, `tabs`, `touches`, `user`, and `expect(fn).toTouchAtMost(n, { runs })`. Query by role/label/text; `user` actions and `clock.advance` end in `flush()`, so never sleep or `waitFor`.

## Diagnostics

`kerf docs <code>` explains one. Also flagged: an early `return` in a `.map` callback (W013), raw `addEventListener`, `setInterval` or sockets with no cleanup (W050), and a `watch` that folds a stream (W052) or copies a live value into `state` (W056).

Test checks (`kerf check` on test files): T001–T009, T013. No assertion, tautologies, sleeps, `container`/selectors/test ids, mocking kerf, snapshots, conditional `expect`, `.only`/`.skip`. To allow one: `// kerf-allow T00x: <reason>`.

Before a change is done, see it work (`kerf browser snapshot|act|assert`, or `__kerf__.agent` in your own browser) and run `kerf test --gate`: new tests must fail on the old code and kill a mutant (T010, T011, T020). `kerf build` audits its pages at phone and desktop width (L-codes) and fails on an error. More: `kerf docs verify`.

Before publishing, set `build.audit.indexing` (`public` or `private`) and audit the deployed URL: `kerf audit --url <url> --indexing public`. Never drop a private noindex for a score.

Before release, configure a source-specific `site.security` CSP with `script-src 'nonce-{kerf}' 'strict-dynamic'`. Trusted Types uses `kerf-html` plus narrowly validated app policies. Never nonce arbitrary page HTML, add unsafe-eval or a permissive default policy. Test live headers, navigation, streaming, forms, media and Save under enforcement. HSTS subdomains/preload need owner-approved HTTPS scope. Read `kerf docs config`.

Trace layout before changing it: batch reads before writes, defer decoders until preparation/playback and third parties until after paint. Verify complete social cards, published page JSON-LD, robots and sitemap. Describe silent artwork; captions must match actual audio. Never add empty tracks or remove content for a score.

## Full stack

`@kerf-js/start` app: file routes in `src/routes` (`_layout.tsx`, `[id].tsx`, `load`, `meta`), server functions in `src/server/**` or `*.server.ts`. Import your own code as `#/server/todos` (`src/server/todos`); generated files are `kerf:slot/<id>` and `kerf:tokens/<name>`.

- **Reads:** `query({ tags: ['todos'], auth: 'user', run: ({ ctx }) => ctx.db.select().from(todos) })`. In a component `todos().value ?? []`; in `load` and handlers `await todos.fetch()`.
- **Writes:** `mutation({ input, auth: 'user', invalidates: ['todos'], optimistic, run })`.
- **Content an owner edits** (menu, settings, pages): read with `cache: { life: 'hours', warm: true }`; edits go to a draft (`preview.start(id)` shows the owner), publishing applies it, slow follow-ups go in `after()`. `kerf docs start` § Publishing.
- **Database:** Drizzle; `await` every statement. Schema change: `kerf db generate` (Q015). Inputs: `schemas.todos.insert.pick({ title: true })`.
- **Auth:** `ctx.user` is the user or `null`; `auth: 'user'` refuses anyone else (A002), `{ role: 'admin' }` or `{ can: (ctx) => … }` the wrong user (A006). With auth on, mutations need a signed-in user unless `auth: 'public'` (sign-in, sign-up, sign-out). Guard pages with `redirect('/login')` in a layout's `load`; `run` still checks who owns a row. Sessions live in the database; pages cache them 5 minutes in a signed cookie (`session.cookieCache`). JWTs are API-only (`api: { functions }`).
- **Never** copy query results into `state`, import `db` from a component (Q012), `fetch` `/_kerf/*`, or poll (`todos.live()`; rooms: `channel`).
- **Navigation:** chrome shared by sections (sidebar, tabs) goes in the one layout above them, following `currentPath()`: a per-section `_layout.tsx` is replaced on each move. Route changes show a skeleton from the page's markup; `export const skeleton = Named` (plain markup, class and data-* only) overrides it.
- **Shared marks:** match `data-kerf-shared` keys; add `data-kerf-shared-fit="text"` for text. Start captures before the optimistic path swap. Respect reduced motion; never add a delayed logo clone around `navigate`.
- **Every page sets `meta` as you build it**, from `data` and `params`: `kerf docs meta`.

## Styling

**Run `kerf style find <what it is>` first**, then reuse a group or add an axis value; never class lists. New: `const card = group('card', { base: { pad: 'group' }, axes: { status: { late: { tone: 'critical' } } } })` from `@kerf-js/core/style`, `<li {...card({ status })}>`. Tokens only. D001–D007, D011, D012, D020–D025, D030–D041, W060: `kerf docs style`, `kerf docs design`; `kerf fix` applies the safe fixes.

## Commands

| Command | Does | Side effects |
|---|---|---|
| `kerf check --json` | Compile every component in check mode and report W- and P-diagnostics with fixes | none |
| `kerf docs <topic>` | Print a docs topic or a diagnostic code (`kerf docs W014`) | none |
| `kerf add` | Install a plugin and wire it into the config (`--dry-run` shows the changes) | fs:kerf.config.*, fs:package.json, network:install |
| `kerf dev` | Dev server | network:listen |
| `kerf build` | Production build and contract | fs:.output/** |
| `kerf db` | `generate`: new migrations | fs:drizzle/**, fs:migrations/**, fs:prisma/** |
| `kerf test` | The test gate on the diff (`--gate`) | fs:.kerf/gate |
| `kerf browser` | Drive the running app in any open browser by role/label/text (`kerf browser help`) | network:dev-server, fs:.kerf/browser |
| `kerf run` | Run a project task by name | task |

`kerf tasks --json` lists the rest.

## Plugins

### Media (@kerf-js/media)

- Use ?media + mediaFfmpeg() and Core Media. Sharp responsive frame-zero stills are automatic; no blur.
- video.firstFrameQuality:{target:90} opts into measured previews; defaults stay exact. Re-ingest old records.
- Pin display quality before loading; reveal a presented full-size frame. Preserve source on pause, return and loop.
- Media warms starts automatically. Save Data, hidden tabs, buffering and cache caps stop speculation; warm={false} opts out.
- HLS: use mediaHlsConfig + supportsMediaStreaming from @kerf-js/media/browser before native fallback.
- Only LCP gets priority + sizes. Describe alt; decoration uses alt="" decorative.
- delivery:auto compares codecs, containers and frames; native wins ties. video.lossless:false needs quality.target.
- Save stays exact: encoder:compatible, swap:manual; prepareMediaSave on intent, release on close. Never flatten motion.

### Video and audio (@kerf-js/media-ffmpeg)

- GIFs, videos and audio files are `?media` imports rendered with `<Media>`. Never hand-write `<video>` or `<source>`.
- Sync code to them with `timeline(asset, { cues })` from `@kerf-js/core/media` and `<Media timeline={t}>`, not `timeupdate` listeners.
- `./loop.gif?media&audio=./beat.opus` muxes the audio into the video at build.
